Filtered and quantized fastText Korean word vectors
Original authors: Edouard Grave, Piotr Bojanowski, Prakhar Gupta, Armand Joulin, Tomas Mikolov.
Original: https://dl.fbaipublicfiles.com/fasttext/vectors-crawl/cc.ko.300.vec.gz
Reference: https://fasttext.cc/docs/en/crawl-vectors.html
